forbidden.name: no-typesense-in-the-browser
forbidden.comment: The Typesense admin key lives in src/lib/search/client.ts, and the browser must never reach it, not even transitively: client components and stories ask the Next server instead (SSR search pages, /api/navigator-search, Payload hooks - docs/search.md). src/app is not in the from-set on purpose: it mixes server components that legitimately import the search modules with client ones, so a static rule there would be all noise; UI code lives in src/components.
